description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across grouped model layer ranges for four methods/configurations, with a dashed baseline reference. The x-axis is categorical with five tick labels—“Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32”—spaced evenly. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale ranging from about −25% to +5%, with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%; a gray dashed horizontal line marks the baseline at 0% (“Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”). The yellow line with circular markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) stays close to 0% across all layer groups, sitting near 0% at Layer1-4 and Layer5-12, dipping slightly below 0% around Layer13-20 (roughly around −1% to −2%), then returning to near 0% at Layer21-28 and Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) starts near 0% at Layer1-4, moves slightly negative at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point around Layer13-20 (approximately −4% to −5%), then rises toward about −1% at Layer21-28 and ends just below 0% at Layer29-32. The light-blue line with circular markers (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) begins slightly below 0% at Layer1-4 (around −2%), declines further at Layer5-12 (around −3%), drops to its minimum near Layer13-20 (around −13%), then increases to around −2% at Layer21-28 and finishes near −1% at Layer29-32. The dark-blue line with square markers (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) starts around −3% at Layer1-4, decreases to roughly −4% at Layer5-12, reaches the lowest value on the chart at Layer13-20 (about −25%), then rises to around −5% at Layer21-28 and ends near −3% at Layer29-32.
